summary: Iter 232L follow-up (Categories column cap removal + trades.py/Transactions.tsx refactor) verified end-to-end. Backend: 2/2 unit tests + 6/6 live-API tests (1 skipped) all green after the extraction of hydration helpers into routes/trade_hydration.py. GET /leagues/{id}/pending-trades returns trade.scoring_categories.skater with exactly 10 default counting cats (G, A, +/-, PIM, PPG, PPP, SHG, SHP, GWG, SOG), and 6 goalie cats. McDavid asset hydrated with age=29, cap_hit=$13.5M, gp=82, fpts=520.0, fpg=6.34, and all 10 stat_categories with correct values (48G/90A/+17/44 PIM/13 PPG/54 PPP/1 SHG/2 SHP/4 GWG/306 SOG). Celebrini side: age=20, cap=$12.05M, gp=77, fpts=434.0, fpg=5.64. Frontend: /transactions renders Pending McDavid↔Celebrini trade card. FPts view has 7 cols/side (Player, Pos, Age, Cap Hit, GP, FPts, FP/G). Categories view has 14 cols/side (4 fixed + 10 categories) — ALL 10 target cats present, no 8-column cap. Toggle persists to localStorage 'transactions.viewMode' and survives page reload. Asset table container has overflow-x-auto, all <th> use whitespace-nowrap. Mobile viewport (390px) also uses overflow-x-auto. 15/16 data-testids present (transactions-filters-clear is conditionally rendered only when a filter is active — verified in source at line 315-329, not a bug). No import/render errors in the refactored transactions/ modules.
action_items: None — all acceptance criteria for the iter 232L follow-up (categories cap removal + refactor) are met.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/trade_hydration.py (223 lines) is a clean, single-purpose extraction: STAT_CATEGORY_LABELS + hydrate_trade_assets + hydrate_trades + private helpers (_hydrate_side, _resolve_cap_hit, _compute_age, _is_pick_asset, _fetch_scoring_config, _asset_stat_categories, _order_categories). Uses a deps dict (setup(deps)) so calculate_fantasy_points stays shared with scoring/roster — no duplicate math.

routes/trades.py now aliases the module's helpers as _hydrate_trade_assets/_hydrate_trades (L51-54) and forwards deps via _trade_hydration_setup(deps) at L32. All 5 GET endpoints still hydrate (L1192, 1303, 1314, 1333, 1364). Backwards-compat preserved — test_iter232L_trade_asset_hydration.py imports the same names and still passes without modification.

trades.py went from 2257 → 2096 lines. Still >700 threshold, but the biggest reusable helper block was extracted cleanly. Further extraction (conditional trade evaluation, trade state machine) could be a future iter.

Transactions.tsx went from 1266 → 539 lines — well under the 700 threshold. Extracted modules: types.ts (86L incl. selectCategoriesForAssets), statusConfig.ts (17L), TradeCard.tsx (212L), ConditionalTradeCard.tsx (343L incl. PickUpgradeRow/ConditionalAssetTable/ConditionEvalRow/describeCondition), StatViewToggle.tsx (35L), mapTrade.ts (87L). Clean domain boundaries.

selectCategoriesForAssets in types.ts renders the FULL scoring_categories list (skater cats + goalie cats appended when a goalie is on the card) — the previous .slice(0, 8) cap is gone. Verified live: TFHL default scoring renders all 10 skater cats.

Both TradeCard.tsx and ConditionalTradeCard.tsx wrap the asset table in <div className="overflow-x-auto -mx-2 sm:mx-0"> and mark every <th> and content <td> with whitespace-nowrap — the two-column trade grid stays intact at both 1920px and 390px; the categories table scrolls horizontally when it overflows.

transactions-filters-clear is (correctly) conditionally rendered only when a filter is active (selectedTeamIds.size>0 || dateFrom || dateTo). Reported as MISSING by the naive selector scan but this is by design — not a defect.
Frontend uses `// @ts-nocheck` per Lovable convention as noted in the review request.
